sections.Profile:
The "Playboy 35th Anniversary" pinball machine, released by Data East in May 1989, commemorates the 35th anniversary of Playboy magazine with a theme centered around a poolside party at Hugh Hefner's Playboy mansion. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and Ed Cebula with artwork by Kevin O'Connor, this solid-state machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two ramps, alongside a 3-ball multiball mode.

- Manufacturer: Data East USA Inc.
- Years made: 1989
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
